name: Generate tract figures (wma_pyTools)
summary: Generates figures for each tract of a white matter classification with wma_pyTools: streamline anatomy plots, density GIFs, multi-tile density plots and endpoint fingerprint plots.
description: Loops over the tracts of a WMC, takes their streamlines from the tractogram and calls wma_pyTools visTools to make the selected figure types, using a parcellation or the FreeSurfer Destrieux parcellation to label streamline endpoints. Use it to produce quality-control and publication figures of segmented tracts. The README is an unfilled template.

inputs.description: Tractogram (.tck) the WMC was built from.
White matter classification defining the tracts to plot.
Optional T1w used as the anatomical background of the figures.

The 2009 freesurfer parcellation will be used for determining endpoint locations / identities for the purposes of the "fingerprint" plot (also, alternatively, as the color scheme selector for the streamline plot).
The desired parcellation to be used for labeled regions in the "fingerprint" plot (also, alternatively, as the color scheme selector for the streamline plot).  WILL OVERRIDE FREESURFER INPUT.

outputs.description: Folder of PNG and GIF figures for each tract.

parameters.description: Produce general streamline anatomy plot (color-coded in accordance with morphological characteristics).
Produce "fingerprint" plots (radial bar-plots indicating streamline termination locations).
Whether or not to inflate the passed parcellation and, if so, by how many voxel iterations.
